goal: Fix bitcoin-cli failing immediately on macOS when run with -rpcclienttimeout=0
Ensure socket waits do not exceed system timeout limits on macOS and BSDs
agreement: Substantive support across multiple platforms with no remaining objections
Verified by reproducing the bug locally on macOS (fjahr)
Verified by building and testing on Windows 10 and FreeBSD 15 (winterrdog)

categories.name: build
why: P2 because it fixes a supported-platform regression on macOS
Resolves an OS-level EINVAL failure that breaks bitcoin-cli under default no-timeout settings

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it fixes broken RPC client connectivity when users specify -rpcclienttimeout=0
Resolves an immediate connection failure caused by mapping zero to an excessive timeout

categories.name: utils
why: P2 because it protects core socket waiting utilities from overflowing OS select and poll limits
Prevents system-level errors for any callers requesting multi-year timeouts
